## Summary

**Case:** CASE-004 — ledger-only exception, GL-0047, James Group, BILL-5051, −$11,541.85

**Classification:** `duplicate`

**Key evidence:**
- `find_transactions_by_reference('BILL-5051')` returns **two ledger entries but only one bank line**.
- **GL-0042** (2026-08-07, −11,541.85) is already matched to **BNK-0036** (ACH DEBIT JAMES GROUP, 2026-08-07, −11,541.85) — the bill was paid in full.
- **GL-0047** (2026-08-10) is an identical −11,541.85 posting: same vendor, same reference, same description, no bank counterpart.
- **DOC-028** (vendor bill) shows a single amount due of USD 11,541.85 — only one payment was ever owed.

**Why not timing_difference:** an uncleared payment would need an outstanding obligation. The bill's full amount was already settled by BNK-0036, so there is nothing left for a second payment to clear.

**Proposed fix (pending human approval, nothing posted):**

| Account | Debit | Credit |
|---|---|---|
| 1000 Cash - Operating | 11,541.85 | |
| 2000 Accounts Payable | | 11,541.85 |

This reverses the duplicate, restoring the cash wrongly shown as paid and reinstating the payable that was relieved twice.

**Flagged for the reviewer:** the only residual uncertainty is whether a genuine second disbursement to James Group exists that clears after the 2026-08-31 statement cut-off. Nothing in the available bank, ledger or document data supports that, but it is the one scenario that would change the classification.

input.explanation:
BILL-5051 (James Group) carries two ledger entries but only one bank line. GL-0042 (2026-08-07, -11,541.85) is already matched to bank line BNK-0036 (ACH DEBIT JAMES GROUP, 2026-08-07, -11,541.85), which settles the bill in full. GL-0047 (2026-08-10) is a second, identical -11,541.85 posting for the same vendor, same reference and same description, with no corresponding bank line.

The vendor bill DOC-028 shows a single amount due of USD 11,541.85 for BILL-5051, so only one payment was ever owed and only one left the bank. There is no evidence of a second obligation or a second disbursement, so GL-0047 is a duplicate posting rather than a payment still in transit (a timing difference would require an unpaid amount due, which the bill does not show).

Proposed fix: reverse the duplicate entry — debit 1000 Cash - Operating 11,541.85 to restore the cash overstated as paid, and credit 2000 Accounts Payable 11,541.85 to undo the double relief of the vendor liability. Note: the vendor bill is dated 2026-07-17 with Net 30 terms; if the accountant has any record of a genuine second disbursement to James Group clearing after 2026-08-31, this should be re-examined before approval, but nothing in the available data supports that.
